title: Lightdash Failures by Chart
app: Lightdash application logs via UF and the Lightdash API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=lightdash:app level="error" OR status="failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by chart_uuid
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Lightdash failures grouped by chart so operators immediately see which specific charts are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Lightdash is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Lightdash failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical charts.
visualization: Table of chart by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Lightdash are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
